metadata.title: Player-Level Descriptive Batting and Bowling Metric Definitions
metadata.project: Rajasthan Royals SupeRR Selector Season 2 Analysis
metadata.scope_boundaries: Descriptive statistics only. No composite scores, rankings, weights, shrinkage, expected-run models (xR), or arbitrary thresholds.

clean_deliveries.description: Standard deliveries off the bat with no illegal bowling or extraneous penalty. Sole input to clean numerators and denominators.

wides.description: Illegal deliveries not faced by the batter. Excluded from clean deliveries and legal balls. 1-run penalty is unrecorded in source data.

oversteps.description: No-balls faced by the batter. Batter runs off the bat are present in runs column, but 1-run penalty is unrecorded and non-boundary runs attribution is unverified. Excluded from clean deliveries and legal deliveries.

byes.description: Legal deliveries where runs are awarded to the team total, not the batter. Included in legal deliveries; excluded from clean deliveries off the bat.

legbyes.description: Legal deliveries where runs are off the pad/body and awarded to team total. Included in legal deliveries; excluded from clean deliveries off the bat.

unresolved_extras.description: Unclassified delivery events in source data. Excluded from clean and legal deliveries pending official clarification.

pressure_cohorts.f1_primary: All deliveries from the 2nd wicket (W2) through innings end for innings where W2 occurred at overid <= 8.
pressure_cohorts.f1_alt1a_all: All deliveries from W2 through exactly 60 legal deliveries (or innings end if truncated) for innings where W2 occurred at overid <= 8.
pressure_cohorts.f1_alt1a_complete_60: Subset of Alt 1A where exactly 60 verified legal deliveries were completed without reaching innings end or unresolved extras.
pressure_cohorts.f1_alt1a_truncated: Subset of Alt 1A where the innings terminated before reaching 60 verified legal deliveries.
pressure_cohorts.f1_alt1a_uncertain: Subset of Alt 1A where an unclassified extra ('other' or 'Penalty') occurred before the 60th legal delivery endpoint.
pressure_cohorts.f4_knockout: All deliveries bowled in the 20 official IPL playoff / knockout matches across IPL 2022 to IPL 2026.
pressure_cohorts.f1_f4_union: Union of deliveries eligible under F1 Primary or F4 Knockout (103,394 unique deliveries with 0 double-counting).

split_types.career: Overall career aggregation within the specified pressure cohort across all available matches and seasons.
split_types.season: Aggregation grouped by individual season within the specified pressure cohort.
split_types.competition: Aggregation grouped by individual competition and season within the specified pressure cohort.

pressure_deliveries_faced.label: Pressure Deliveries Faced (Total)
pressure_deliveries_faced.description: Total delivery events where the player was the on-strike batter in the pressure cohort. Reconciles exactly with cohort delivery totals.

batter_balls_faced.label: Batter Balls Faced (Excluding Wides)
batter_balls_faced.description: Total deliveries where the batter physically faced a bowled ball (includes clean balls, Oversteps, byes, and legbyes).

clean_deliveries_faced.label: Clean Deliveries Faced
clean_deliveries_faced.description: Deliveries faced by the batter with zero extras. Strict denominator for clean batting scoring rate.

clean_batter_runs.label: Clean Batter Runs
clean_batter_runs.description: Runs scored directly off the bat on clean deliveries. Excludes Overstep runs and team extras.

clean_scoring_rate.label: Clean-Delivery Scoring Rate
clean_scoring_rate.description: Ratio of clean runs scored to clean balls faced. Defined strictly on clean deliveries. Must NOT be labeled conventional strike rate.

fours_off_bat.label: Fours Off The Bat
fours_off_bat.description: Boundaries of 4 runs awarded off the bat.

sixes_off_bat.label: Sixes Off The Bat
sixes_off_bat.description: Boundaries of 6 runs awarded off the bat.

all_run_fours.label: All-Run Fours
all_run_fours.formula: COUNT(delivery WHERE runs == 4 AND is_four == False)
all_run_fours.description: Deliveries where 4 runs were scored via running between the wickets without a boundary flag.

all_run_sixes.label: All-Run Sixes
all_run_sixes.formula: COUNT(delivery WHERE runs == 6 AND is_six == False)
all_run_sixes.description: Deliveries where 6 runs were scored via running between the wickets without a boundary flag.

striker_dismissals_total.label: Striker Dismissals (Total)
striker_dismissals_total.formula: COUNT(delivery WHERE is_wicket == True AND dismissed_player_id == striker_id)
striker_dismissals_total.description: Total times the on-strike batter was dismissed in the pressure cohort. Non-striker run-outs are strictly excluded.

coverage.matches_faced: Distinct count of match_id where the player faced at least one pressure delivery.
coverage.innings_faced: Distinct count of (match_id, innings) where the player faced at least one pressure delivery.
coverage.competitions_faced: Distinct count of comp_id where the player faced at least one pressure delivery.
coverage.seasons_faced: Distinct count of season where the player faced at least one pressure delivery.

pressure_deliveries_bowled_total.label: Pressure Deliveries Bowled (Total)
pressure_deliveries_bowled_total.description: Total delivery attempts bowled in the pressure cohort, including wides and Oversteps. Reconciles exactly with cohort delivery totals.

legal_deliveries_bowled.label: Legal Deliveries Bowled
legal_deliveries_bowled.description: Deliveries credited toward completed overs. Excludes wides, Oversteps, and unresolved extras.

bowler_credited_wickets.label: Bowler-Credited Wickets
bowler_credited_wickets.formula: COUNT(delivery WHERE is_wicket == True AND dismissal_type IN ('Bowled', 'Caught', 'LBW', 'Stump', 'Hit Wicket'))
bowler_credited_wickets.description: Dismissals officially credited to the bowler's bowling record. Excludes run-outs, retired outs, and obstructing the field.

legal_balls_per_credited_wicket.label: Legal Deliveries Per Credited Wicket
legal_balls_per_credited_wicket.description: Average legal balls bowled per bowler-credited wicket. Reported as null when bowler_credited_wickets == 0.

clean_deliveries_bowled.label: Clean Deliveries Bowled
clean_deliveries_bowled.description: Bowled deliveries off the bat with zero extras. Strict denominator for clean containment rate.

clean_runs_conceded.label: Clean Runs Conceded
clean_runs_conceded.description: Runs scored directly off the bat against the bowler on clean deliveries.

clean_containment_rate.label: Clean Containment Rate
clean_containment_rate.description: Ratio of clean runs conceded to clean deliveries bowled. Clean numerator over clean denominator.

coverage.matches_bowled: Distinct count of match_id where the bowler bowled at least one pressure delivery.
coverage.innings_bowled: Distinct count of (match_id, innings) where the bowler bowled at least one pressure delivery.
coverage.competitions_bowled: Distinct count of comp_id where the bowler bowled at least one pressure delivery.
coverage.seasons_bowled: Distinct count of season where the bowler bowled at least one pressure delivery.

bowler_total_runs_conceded.reason: Source data omits 1-run penalty for 7,714 wides and 576 Oversteps in the runs column. Reconstructing total runs conceded would require unvalidated imputation of penalty rules.

official_economy_rate.reason: Requires total runs conceded (including wide and no-ball penalties) divided by legal overs. Uncomputable without unrecorded penalty runs.

conventional_batting_strike_rate.reason: Conventional strike rate formula (100 * runs / balls_faced) is statistically compromised due to ambiguity in no-ball run attribution and missing extras penalty tracking.

team_cumulative_runs_and_required_run_ra.reason: Innings target, revised overs, DLS adjustments, and full non-pressure delivery contexts are unverified at the individual delivery row level.
